content_md:
(blog.previdian.com) Two-Stage SharePoint Exploitation Attempts Targeting CVE-2026-65660: Analysis of Pre-Authentication RCE Chain and Websh

via Mastodon https://blog.previdian.com/cve-2026-65660-previdian-observes-two-stage-sharepoint-exploitation-attempts/

CVE-2026-65660.evidence: Previdian captured 12 exploitation requests against a SharePoint honeypot on 24 Sep 2026 chaining an anonymous delivery bug with CVE-2026-65660 for pre-auth RCE; its 25 Sep update reports exploitation creates a webshell backdoor at /_layouts/15/sphealth.aspx.
